provenance: Static presentation rules only. They do not change deterministic score, status, or engine recommendations.

retrieval_success.title: Make the page reachable
retrieval_success.reason: The page could not be read.
retrieval_success.action: Check that the page opens without sign-in or a server error.

http_status.title: Return a successful page response
http_status.reason: The server did not return a successful page response.
http_status.action: Review the server response and restore the intended page.

https.title: Use a secure page address
https.reason: The final address does not use HTTPS.
https.action: Serve the page over HTTPS and update links that still use HTTP.

content_type.title: Serve a readable HTML page
content_type.reason: The response was not identified as an HTML page.
content_type.action: Return the page as text/html or application/xhtml+xml.

redirects.title: Shorten the route to this page
redirects.reason: The page takes several redirects to reach its final address.
redirects.action: Point links to the final address when that is the intended destination.

fetch_duration.title: Review the observed response time
fetch_duration.reason: The request took longer than the range used by this check.
fetch_duration.action: Review server response timing separately from browser rendering speed.
fetch_duration.snippet_reason: A fetch duration does not identify a specific code change.

robots_directives.title: Review this crawler directive
robots_directives.reason: A crawler directive appears in the available page or response details.

copy_rules.title: Review whether this page should be indexed
copy_rules.reason: A noindex instruction appears in the page or response details. Confirm it is intended before changing it.
copy_rules.verdict: This page tells search engines not to index it.

copy_rules.reason: No crawler directive was found in the available page or response details.

robots_directives.action: Confirm the directive's intended effect before changing it.
robots_directives.snippet_reason: Changing a crawler directive requires page-owner intent; no removal is proposed.

title.title: Write a clear page title
title.reason: The page title may not clearly identify the page topic.
title.action: Write one accurate title using verified page content.
title.snippet_note: Editable text is a placeholder, not verified page copy.

meta_description.title: Add a page description
meta_description.reason: The page does not provide a description for its preview.
meta_description.action: Write a concise, accurate description using only confirmed page information.
meta_description.snippet_template: <meta name="description" content="[Write an accurate summary of this page]">
meta_description.snippet_note: Editable text is a placeholder, not verified page copy.

canonical.title: Confirm the preferred page address
canonical.reason: The canonical address is missing or its relationship to this page needs checking.
canonical.action: Confirm which address should represent this page before adding or changing the tag.
canonical.snippet_note: Draft from the observed final address; confirm that it is the preferred address.

h1_structure.title: Add one main heading
h1_structure.reason: The page is missing a clear main heading.
h1_structure.action: Write one heading that accurately describes the page's main subject.
h1_structure.snippet_template: [Write a heading based on the page content]
h1_structure.snippet_note: Editable text is a placeholder, not verified page copy.

heading_hierarchy.title: Put headings in a clear order
heading_hierarchy.reason: The heading levels do not form a clear reading outline.
heading_hierarchy.action: Review the heading order so sections follow the page's content structure.
heading_hierarchy.snippet_reason: The analyzer reports heading structure, not the intended outline.

visible_text.title: Review whether the page explains its subject
visible_text.reason: A word count alone cannot tell whether this page covers what readers need.
visible_text.action: Check the page against its purpose; this check does not set a universal word target.
visible_text.snippet_reason: The analyzer returns a count, not enough page text to draft content.

internal_links.title: Link to related pages
internal_links.reason: The page has few links to related sections of this site.
internal_links.action: Add a relevant internal link only where it helps readers continue.
internal_links.snippet_reason: The analyzer returns link counts, not enough context to choose a destination.

anchor_text.title: Make link labels descriptive
anchor_text.reason: Some links may not explain where they lead.
anchor_text.action: Use concise link text that describes its destination.
anchor_text.snippet_reason: The analyzer does not return the individual link labels.

link_relationships.title: Review link relationship labels
link_relationships.reason: This check did not find relationship attributes that needed action.
link_relationships.action: Add rel attributes only when the link's purpose calls for them.
link_relationships.snippet_reason: The analyzer does not return enough link context to choose an attribute.
link_relationships.exclusion_reason: The analyzer did not apply this check to the returned links.

image_alt.title: Add alt text to informative images
image_alt.reason: An image lacks text that could describe it to someone who cannot see it.
image_alt.action: Describe an image when it communicates information; decorative images can use empty alt text.
image_alt.snippet_note: The source address comes from the saved local HTML; decide whether the image is informative.
image_alt.snippet_reason: No individual image source was returned by the analyzer.

json_ld.title: Correct malformed structured data
json_ld.reason: A structured-data block could not be parsed.
json_ld.action: Review malformed blocks and confirm their values against the page.
json_ld.snippet_reason: The analyzer does not return enough property context to draft a safe block.

ignore_when.reason: No structured-data block was returned. Its absence is optional, so no fix is assumed.

open_graph.title: Complete the sharing preview details
open_graph.reason: Some optional page details are missing from its Open Graph preview.
open_graph.action: Add verified page details only if this page needs a social sharing preview.
open_graph.snippet_reason: The analyzer does not provide verified replacement copy for missing fields.

twitter_metadata.title: Complete the X preview details
twitter_metadata.reason: The page does not provide the full set of X preview details.
twitter_metadata.action: Use confirmed page title and description values if an X preview is needed.
twitter_metadata.snippet_reason: The analyzer does not provide verified replacement copy for missing fields.

html_lang.title: Declare the page language
html_lang.reason: The document does not declare the language used for its content.
html_lang.action: Set the language code that matches the page's primary content.
html_lang.snippet_reason: The language should be selected by the page author, not inferred here.

viewport.title: Set a responsive viewport
viewport.reason: The page does not declare a viewport for narrow screens.
viewport.action: Add the standard width=device-width viewport unless the page has a reviewed reason not to.

charset.title: Declare the character encoding
charset.reason: The page does not explicitly declare its character encoding.
charset.action: Declare UTF-8 when it matches the page content.
charset.snippet_note: Confirm this encoding matches the saved page content.
